topics.name: component quality
topics.description: The physical production: cards, miniatures, boards, tokens, dice and the box insert.

topics.name: rules and learning curve
topics.description: How easy the game is to learn and teach: rulebook clarity, player aids and first-game confusion.

topics.name: difficulty and balance
topics.description: How hard the game is to win, how much luck decides outcomes and whether the heroes are evenly matched.

topics.name: art and graphic design
topics.description: Illustrations, iconography and how readable the text and symbols are.

topics.name: replayability and variety
topics.description: How much variety the scenarios, events and heroes offer over many plays.

topics.name: setup and play time
topics.description: How long setup, teardown and a full game take.

topics.name: theme and story
topics.description: The setting, narrative and how strongly the game makes players feel part of its world.

topics.name: player count scaling
topics.description: How the game changes between two, three, four or more players at the table.

topics.name: solo play
topics.description: Playing the game alone, including the one-player rules and how well they work.

topics.name: component and production quality
topics.description: Physical quality of the miniatures, cards, boards, tokens, dice and box, including defects, damage and storage inserts.

topics.name: rulebook and learning curve
topics.description: How clear or confusing the rulebook, reference aids and teaching process are, including rule mistakes, edge cases and how easily new players learn the game.

topics.name: setup and game length
topics.description: Time and effort spent on setup, teardown and storage, plus how long a session or round runs compared with expectations.

topics.name: artwork and readability
topics.description: Illustration, visual style and graphic design, including legibility of icons, fonts and card text and colour accessibility.

topics.name: difficulty and balance
topics.description: How hard, fair or luck-driven the game is, including swinginess, hero balance, difficulty levels and win rates.

topics.name: replayability and variety
topics.description: Whether scenarios, events, heroes and campaign branching keep the game fresh or become repetitive over repeated plays.

topics.name: player count scaling
topics.description: How the game performs at different numbers of players, from two to five, and how it scales.

topics.name: theme and narrative
topics.description: How well the setting, story, lore and thematic integration work, and whether the theme feels immersive or merely pasted on.

topics.name: editions expansions and add ons
topics.description: Future or alternate releases such as expansions, reprints, translations and deluxe editions, plus third-party organisers, sleeves and fan accessories.

topics.name: solo play
topics.description: Experiences with, questions about and rules for playing alone, including the solo mode, automa and single-hero options.

method.providerLabel: Two-phase topics (Anthropic claude-sonnet-5-5 (topic-discovery-v2) → consolidation (topic-consolidation-v3) + TypeSafe jev-latest (jev-topic-a1), batches of ≤ 25)
